caption: A block of 46 infantry on 10 files turns about in place, then is narrowed to 9 files and ordered forward in the same moment. Squaring its ranks to the new front, it now deals each man a place near where he stands: half a file to the side, and at most a rank and a half forward or half a rank back as the block deepens from 5 ranks to 6, 28.5 wu at the most. Before this fix the re-square sent men up to four and a half ranks along their own file, through the block to its other end, the farthest 81.5 wu.
